The skeptical read is that AMD is levering up to fund AI infrastructure it cannot fund from cash flow, and this is a stock whose recent lesson has been that good news is not enough (blowout Q2, revenue +50% YoY, and it fell). One green session on a debt offering does not retire a month of that. Paying up 4.8% into it, on a FRIDAY that charges a full weekend of theta at -$0.58/day, is not a trade this desk should want.
